# vercel login

Sign in to your Vercel account.

```
vercel login [email or team id]
```

## Examples

Sign in to your Vercel account.

```
$ vercel login
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
